clips.title: 美国空管技术：部分追溯到二战时期，感恩节高峰边飞边修？

subtitles.en: This Thanksgiving tomorrow in America's Transportation Department reckons this holiday period will be the busiest for air travel in 16 years.
subtitles.zh: 明天就是感恩节，美国交通部估计这个假期将是16年来航空旅行最繁忙的时期。

subtitles.en: That's causing concern in some quarters, just weeks after a nationwide ground stop turning attention to America's aging air traffic technology.
subtitles.zh: 这在一些方面引发了担忧，就在几周前，全国范围内的地面停飞让人们的注意力转向美国老化的空中交通技术。

subtitles.en: Let's bring in Bloomberg, managing editor for Space and Aviation, better to camel for more.
subtitles.zh: 让我们请来彭博社太空与航空 managing editor，Better to Camel 了解更多。

subtitles.en: Benny, we're just talking about cyber risks there linked in with the questions of outdated and old infrastructure.
subtitles.zh: Benny，我们刚刚谈到网络风险，这与过时老旧的基础设施问题相关。

subtitles.en: What is the issue with US air traffic technology?
subtitles.zh: 美国空中交通技术存在什么问题？

subtitles.en: Well, one of the big issues with the system is that it is so big and so complex and that it's a living, breathing organism that you have to try and fix as you're using it.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，该系统的一大问题是它如此庞大和复杂，就像一个活生生的有机体，你必须在使用的过程中尝试修复它。

subtitles.en: Imagine you're changing the tyres on a moving car or you're putting your hands into the spokes of a bicycle wheel, that kind of thing.
subtitles.zh: 想象一下你在给行驶中的汽车换轮胎，或者把手伸进自行车轮的辐条里，诸如此类。
en_highlights: changing the tyres on a moving car

subtitles.en: That sort of what we're faced with here that you are trying to operate a system while repairing it and it's a system that has grown over decades in some cases.
subtitles.zh: 这就是我们面临的情况：你试图在运营一个系统的同时修复它，而这个系统在某些情况下已经发展了几十年。
en_highlights: operate a system while repairing it

subtitles.en: Some of the technology, as we reported in our story for this out today, is decades old.
subtitles.zh: 正如我们今天发布的报道所述，一些技术已经有几十年的历史了。
en_highlights: our story for this out today

subtitles.en: It sort of goes back to some of it to World War II kind of technology, obviously updated but always sort of added a bit, tweaked a bit here, taken away something there.
subtitles.zh: 其中一些可以追溯到二战时期的技术，显然已经更新过，但总是这里加一点，那里调整一下，再删掉一些。
en_highlights: World War II kind of technology

subtitles.en: It's never been sort of a system whereby you can stop the whole thing, repair it, reboot it and that's what they have to deal with.
subtitles.zh: 从来不存在那种能整体停机、修复、重启的系统，这就是他们必须面对的现实。

clip_research.source_claim: Some US air traffic control technology dates back to World War II-era technology, updated incrementally over decades, and the system must be repaired while in use.
clip_research.public_baseline: Bloomberg reports the Thanksgiving period will be the busiest US air travel in 16 years, with more than 417,000 flights scheduled over nine days, following a nationwide ground stop that put aging air traffic technology under scrutiny.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The transcript's claim that parts of the system trace to World War II-era technology is a striking detail beyond the general 'outdated' framing in public snippets; the snippets confirm the outage and record travel volume but do not independently verify the WWII-era detail.

evidence.fact: Guest says some technology goes back to World War II-era technology, updated and tweaked over decades.
Guest compares fixing the system to changing tyres on a moving car.

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
